def VTask.comk {α : Type u_1} (p : Set α → Prop) (he : p ∅) (hmono : ∀ (t : Set α), p t → ∀ s ⊆ t, p s) (hunion : ∀ (s : Set α), p s → ∀ (t : Set α), p t → p (s ∪ t)) : Filter α :=
  {
    sets := {s : Set α | p sᶜ},
    -- The filter is defined by the sets whose complements satisfy p.
    univ_mem := by
      -- The universal set is in the filter because its complement is empty, and p(∅) is true.
      have h : p (∅ : Set α) := he
      have h₁ : ((∅ : Set α) : Set α) = (∅ : Set α) := rfl
      have h₂ : p (univᶜ : Set α) := by
        have h₃ : (univ : Set α)ᶜ = (∅ : Set α) := by
          ext x
          simp
        rw [h₃]
        exact he
      simpa using h₂
    -- The empty set is not necessarily in the filter, so we don't need to prove it here.
    -- Instead, we need to prove that if a set is in the filter, then any superset of it is also in the filter.
    up_mem := by
      intro s hs t ht
      have h₁ : p sᶜ := hs
      have h₂ : sᶜ ⊆ tᶜ := by
        intro x hx
        -- If x is in the complement of s, then x is not in s.
        -- Since t is a superset of s, x is also not in t.
        have h₃ : x ∉ s := hx
        have h₄ : x ∉ t := by
          intro h₅
          have h₆ : x ∈ s := ht h₅
          contradiction
        exact h₄
      -- Since p is downward closed, p(tᶜ) is true.
      have h₃ : p tᶜ := hmono sᶜ h₁ tᶜ h₂
      exact h₃
    -- We need to prove that if two sets are in the filter, then their intersection is also in the filter.
    -- This is equivalent to proving that the union of their complements satisfies p.
    inter_mem := by
      intro s hs t ht
      have h₁ : p sᶜ := hs
      have h₂ : p tᶜ := ht
      -- The complement of the intersection is the union of the complements.
      have h₃ : (s ∩ t)ᶜ = sᶜ ∪ tᶜ := by
        ext x
        simp [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_compl_iff]
        <;> tauto
      -- Since p is closed under unions, p(sᶜ ∪ tᶜ) is true.
      have h₄ : p (sᶜ ∪ tᶜ) := hunion sᶜ h₁ tᶜ h₂
      -- Therefore, p((s ∩ t)ᶜ) is true.
      rw [h₃] at *
      exact h₄
  }
